messages:
sandeep: Handoff for the night — quick summary.
What I did: rotated read replicas (eu-west1), bumped kvcache pool +15% for regen path, and pushed a small routing hotfix (canary at 20%).
Blockers: embed-ingest queue in eu-west1 spiked during the deploy; consumer backlog ~11k and consumer latency briefly hit 260ms. Autoscale is trying but lag is catching up; suspect a cold-KV issue for a subset of prefixes.
Next: left canary at 20% for 20m, will hold. If backlog doesn't drop in 20m, fallback plan is to route to quantized model variant and throttle non-critical batch jobs.

jamie: Ack. I'll watch embed-queue and dashboard for 30m. If backlog grows >15k I'll trigger manual scale and drop canary.

oliver: Just added an autoscale override for embed-consumer in eu-west to +15% until 02:00 UTC. Command used: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-consumer -n eu-west --replicas=23` (rolled in as a short-lived override).

maria: Noted. I also hit the alert runbook — check `embed-queue-depth` and `consumer-p95`. If p95 > 200ms for 3 datapoints, we should flip to fallback model.

deploy-bot: canary rollout to redwood/regression-router:v2 at 20% completed (1799998920). No failures observed in healthchecks.

sandeep: Thanks @jamie @oliver. I've left a small PR for the routing tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/412 — it's non-blocking for now but contains extra logging if we need to trace prefix mismatches.

jamie: LGTM, pinged reviewers. Also asked @eng-infra to pre-warm hot prefixes in kvcache (small warmup job queued).

eng-infra: Warmup job scheduled and running (job id warmup-eu-179). ETA ~6m to complete prewarm for top-500 prefixes.

maria: I'll watch alerts and update if anything changes. If the warmup doesn't bring latency down in 10m, I'll start the fallback route and notify support.

sandeep: Handoff complete — I'm offline after 21:00 UTC, primary for the remainder of the night is @jamie. Reach me on call only for urgent P0s. :thumbsup:
